name: Витрина «За Энериум»: пятеро «Отмеченных» — донатный сет цикла VI, вершина витрины: пять бойцов урона с пятью доблестями (ADR-0021, ADR-0022, ADR-0023, п. 9–10). Безликие — без лица. Рецепт — jobs/donat-set4.json (усиленная рамка Безликих; нижний край режет фигуру по поясу, низ без плашки). Сет — лучшие первого поколения, на которых посмотрел свой бог (свод, «Взор и сломанные»); боги тогда ходили путниками в рясах и учили руками. Бога не рисуем — только примету взора: в груди героя горит свет цвета его школы, как переполненные песочные часы (главы: «часы в груди налились жаром до горла», «наполнялись, как сосуд под струёй», «наполнились доверху», «переполнились, как лёгкие на вдохе», «песок в груди встал»). Что было с ними после взора — только команде, в промт не идёт. Место — молодой мир первого века: берег холодного моря до Арены, камни у воды, первая жила, молодой лес, первая школа Времени. Источники: docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, сет VI; главы — design/ui/roster.js, c6-59…c6-63. У Гислы — рудознатица ловкости с парой лёгких кирок (решение агента: «прыть ума», по состав-героев.md)
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, precious, regal: rich materials — old gold, dark bronze, black stone, deep green velvet. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold green light of time-crystals against warm gold. Fine sand and dust motes float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no writing on stones, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no name plate, no dark band at the bottom, no gems or badges of rank. No face: no pale face-like surface, no smooth mask, no eye holes, no eyes inside the hood or head-covering. No animal head on a hood. No violet robe. No god, no second figure, no giant eye in the sky. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the picture; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin, not a statue.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view: the bottom edge of the picture cuts the body at the belt or the hips; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they were; the pose carries weight and intent. The head in the upper third; the lower part of the picture sinks gradually into deeper shadow — no band, no plate, nothing written. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below; rim light separates the figure from the background.

This hero is one of the Faceless: a soul of the distant past whose face has long been worn away, and who does not remember who they were. Where the face should be, inside the hood or head-covering, there is only a smooth, soft, deep darkness, as dark as a night sky — no pale surface, no smooth mask, no eye holes, no eyes, no glowing eyes, no nose, no mouth, no skull, no features at all in that darkness; the face is rubbed away like the face of an old coin. Everything else about the hero is vivid and specific: the clothing, the silhouette, the weapon and above all the hands — alive, strong and expressive. Fine green sand of time drifts from the edges of the cloak and from the fingertips and floats upward — the mark of the timeless. The rarity is the highest in the game: the portrait feels precious and regal, with old gold highlights and deep green light.

These are the Marked — the best fighters of the first generation, in the young world of the first age, when the gods walked the land as wanderers in robes and taught people with their hands. Each of them was once looked upon by their own god, and that gaze was more than a person can hold. The god is never shown. The mark of the gaze: in the middle of the hero's chest a light burns in the colour of their school, as if the hourglass of their heart were filled to overflowing; it glows through the clothing. This set is the summit of the showcase: the most magnificent, heroic and dangerous of all the Faceless — legends at the moment of their greatest deed, with the richest light and the boldest pose.

jobs.title: Хальвард Первая Секира — Безликий, физ ДД силы, Огонь, донатный сет VI «Отмеченные», 1-й (c6-59)
jobs.source: Главы c6-59: «Кулак учителя» (учитель бил, пока не поймёшь), «Двуручная секира» (секира по плечо, одной рукой не удержать; она была первой), «Страх, который не ушёл» (страх стоял рядом, как второй в строю), «Песок до Арены» (светлый мелкий песок у холодного моря, ни стен, ни скамей), «Взор Кэрона» (часы в груди налились жаром до горла). Решение агента: удар двуручной секирой вправо, алое пламя по лезвию; алый свет в груди до горла — примета взора; его тень на песке тянется рядом, как второй в строю. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c6-59.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Halvard First-Axe, a man of the first generation, one of the Faceless, a warrior of great strength of the Fire school. Who he is: the best fighter of the first generation, taught by a wanderer-god himself — the teacher did not explain, he struck until you understood. His axe reached his shoulder and could not be held in one hand; it was the first of its kind. His fear never left him — it stood beside him like a second man in the line, and he learned to fight shoulder to shoulder with it. On a beach of pale sand by a cold sea, long before any arena existed, he went out against his teacher knowing he would lose, and lost standing to the last blow. Right now he swings the first axe. Character: fierce, afraid and unstoppable — courage that walks side by side with fear; a huge, scarred warrior. Pose, the moment of the blow: the camera is low; he strides toward the right across the sand, his torso twisted, his shoulders rolled back. He has exactly two arms: both hands swing a great two-handed axe from high over his far shoulder down toward the right in one tremendous blow; the broad bronze head, large and close to the camera near the top of the picture, trails scarlet fire of the Fire school. Details that tell his story: (1) a heavy hood of rough brown wool frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) both hands are thick with calluses, the knuckles scarred; (3) a scarlet light burns in the middle of his chest through his leather jerkin, rising up to his throat — the mark of the god's gaze; (4) his long shadow on the sand stretches beside him like a second warrior in the line; (5) the cold sea foams on the sand behind him. Place: a wide beach of fine pale sand by a cold grey sea at dusk in the first age: no walls, no benches, only footprints washed by the tide. Scarlet light from the axe and from glowing cracks in the wet sand below; green time-sand drifts around him.

jobs.title: Тьерри Молот Заповедей — Безликий, физ ДД силы, Вода, донатный сет VI «Отмеченные», 2-й (c6-60)
jobs.source: Главы c6-60: «Десять слов» (слышал их из уст того, кто их принёс; видел пыль на подоле рясы), «Щит и молот» (щит на левой, молот в правой; молот — бить последним, когда всё сказано; щит — чтобы успеть выслушать), «Выслушанный», «Камни у воды» (широкая река рвётся на рукава и падает к морю; учитель высекал слова на камнях — носили воду смачивать резец), «Взор Армонта» (часы в груди наполнялись, как сосуд под струёй, до края и выше). Решение агента: удар молотом через кромку щита, волна синего света Воды; синий свет в груди переливается через край; большие гладкие камни у воды — без знаков. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c6-60.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Thierry Hammer-of-the-Commandments, a man of the first generation, one of the Faceless, a warrior of great strength of the Water school. Who he is: he heard the ten words from the very mouth of the one who brought them, standing so close he saw the dust on the hem of the robe. Shield on the left arm, hammer in the right — as his teacher held them: the shield to have time to listen, the hammer to strike last, when everything has been said. He carried water to the stones by the river where the teacher cut the words, and came back alone to check that not one had worn away. Right now he brings the hammer down — last, after everything has been said. Character: just, steadfast and terrible in judgment — a man who never says more than is needed. Pose, the moment of the blow: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right, braced, his shoulders driving forward. He has exactly two arms: his near arm raises a round shield of oak bound with bronze toward the right; his far hand brings a heavy war hammer down over the rim of the shield toward the right, and a crashing wave of blue light of the Water school bursts from the hammer's head. Details that tell his story: (1) a hood of undyed wool frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) a blue light burns in the middle of his chest through his clothing, brimming over like a vessel under a stream — the mark of the god's gaze; (3) a leather water-skin at his belt; (4) the rim of the shield is worn smooth; (5) behind him, large plain stones stand by the water — no marks on them. Place: the bank where a great river breaks into branches and falls to the sea, in the first age, at dusk: large plain stones, rushing water, no houses at all. Blue light rises from the water below; green time-sand drifts around him.

jobs.title: Гисла Прыткая — Безликая, дворфийка, физ ДД ловкости, Земля, донатный сет VI «Отмеченные», 3-я (c6-61)
jobs.source: Главы c6-61: «Первая жила» (находила жилу раньше, чем другие брались за кирку; запах сырой, железный и чуть сладкий), «Прыть» (прыть в голове, а не в ногах), «Вопрос без ответа» (учитель с посохом спросил, знает ли она себя), «Посох на камне» (повторяла за учителем костяшками пальцев, пока не сбила их в кровь), «Взор Улариона» (часы в груди наполнились доверху, как забой водой). Решение агента: быстрый выпад парой лёгких кирок вправо, из остриёв — янтарные вспышки Земли; сбитые костяшки; янтарный свет в груди — примета взора; косы из тьмы капюшона, без бороды (как принятая дворфийка c2-41). К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c6-61.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Gisla the Swift, a dwarf woman of the first generation, one of the Faceless, a swift fighter of the Earth school. Who she is: the swiftest of the first dwarves — she found a vein before the others had taken up their picks, by a smell damp, iron-like and a little sweet; she understood before anyone finished speaking and left before she had heard the end. Her teacher with the staff once asked her whether she knew herself; she said it did not matter, and he waited so long that she left first. Right now she darts in with twin picks. Character: quick, sharp and restless — a mind that is always a step ahead; she is short and broad, but light and fast. Pose, the moment of the strike: the camera is low; she darts forward toward the right, low and fast, her body twisting into the blow. She has exactly two arms: her near hand strikes forward toward the right with a light prospector's pick, and amber-orange light of the Earth school flashes from its point; her far hand holds a second pick raised high behind her, ready for the next blow. Chips of stone fly. Details that tell her story: (1) a leather hood, and two thick braids that fall from the smooth darkness where her face should be, bound with copper rings — no beard; (2) an amber light burns in the middle of her chest, filling it like a mine filling with water — the mark of the god's gaze; (3) her knuckles are scarred from knocking on stone to listen to it; (4) a miner's leather jerkin and a belt of small pouches of ore; (5) a glowing amber vein in the rock wall behind her. Place: the first mine of the dwarves in the first age: a fresh tunnel of raw rock, a single amber vein shining. Amber light rises from the vein and the cracks below; green time-sand drifts around her.

jobs.title: Сиэран Первая Тетива — Безликий, эльф, физ ДД ловкости, Воздух, донатный сет VI «Отмеченные», 4-й (c6-62)
jobs.source: Главы c6-62: «Лук из рук бога» (лук вложили прямо в руки; дерево ещё живое, пахло соком; путник поправил локоть и ушёл без слова), «Молодой лес» (деревья по плечо), «Один из лучших» (лучшей была она; зависть помнится дольше имени), «Тетива на ветру» (ждал затишья между двумя порывами), «Взор Виала» (часы переполнились, как лёгкие на вдохе, который нельзя выдохнуть). Решение агента: выстрел в миг затишья, стрела уходит вправо в спирали ветра; лук из живого бледного дерева с листьями; бело-зелёный свет в груди — примета взора; кончики ушей сквозь капюшон. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c6-62.jpg. v2: в v1 лук опущен, рука тянется к колчану — выстрела не видно; теперь полный натяг на уровне плеча, стрела вправо
jobs.subject: Subject: Sieran First-Bowstring, an elf of the first generation, one of the Faceless, a swift archer of the Air school. Who he is: the bow was put into his hands by a wanderer-god himself — the wood still alive, as if the branch had been cut that morning; the teacher corrected his elbow, drew back his shoulder and left without a word. The forest was young then, the trees only up to his shoulder. He was one of the best students — and not the best. He waited for the wind to say now: a lull between two gusts so short that others did not hear it. Right now the lull comes, and he looses. Character: patient, proud and quietly envious — perfection that is not quite enough; utterly still before the shot. Pose, the moment before the shot: the camera is low; he stands at the edge of a young forest, turned toward the right, the bow raised at shoulder height and drawn to the full, the arrow on the string pointing straight at the right edge of the picture. He has exactly two arms: his near arm is stretched out toward the right and holds the longbow of living pale wood upright, fresh leaves growing on it; his far hand holds the drawn string back beside the edge of his hood, the fingers about to open. A spiral of pale white-green wind of the Air school coils along the arrow, and around him the grass and the leaves stand still in the lull. Details that tell his story: (1) a hood of green-grey wool frames the smooth darkness where his face should be, and the tips of his long pointed elven ears show through it; (2) a pale white-green light burns in the middle of his chest, like lungs filled with a breath that cannot be let out — the mark of the god's gaze; (3) a quiver of white-fletched arrows; (4) a bracer of pale bark on his bow arm; (5) around him young trees no taller than a man. Place: the edge of a young forest in the first age at dawn: slender trees, an open meadow, a vast bright sky. Pale white-green light rises from the grass below; green time-sand drifts around him.

jobs.title: Ялен — Безликий, маг ДД, Время, донатный сет VI «Отмеченные», 5-й (c6-63)
jobs.source: Главы c6-63: «Школа без платы» (школа брала из того, что и так течёт мимо, задерживала на миг и отпускала), «Лучший в поколении», «Чужие часы» (у детей быстрый ход, у стариков редкий, как капель, у больных сбивчивый; знал, у кого песок на исходе, и молчал), «Ты не главный», «Взор Рэдмунда» (песок в груди встал). Путника с косой не рисуем. Решение агента: миг заклинания — зелёный песок времени встаёт в воздухе вокруг врага справа; вокруг Ялена парят призрачные песочные часы чужих жизней, у каждых свой ход; зелёный свет в груди, песок в нём неподвижен — примета взора. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c6-63.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Yalen, a man of the first generation, one of the Faceless, a battle mage of the Time school. Who he is: the best mage of his generation in the school of Time, when it still asked nothing in return — it took from what flows past anyway, held it for a moment and let it go. He could hear other people's hourglasses: the children's quick, the old ones' slow like drips after rain, the sick ones' stumbling; he knew whose sand was running out before they did, and never said so. Right now he stops the sand of an enemy. Character: quiet, watchful and burdened by silence — the child who watched the grown-ups too carefully, grown into a master. Pose, the moment of the spell: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right. He has exactly two arms: his near hand is raised toward the right, the fingers slowly closing, and around the enemy beyond the right edge the streaming green sand of time halts in mid-air; his far hand is held open at his side, and around him float many small, ghostly hourglasses of green light, each running at its own pace. Details that tell his story: (1) a deep hood of dark green wool frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) a green light burns in the middle of his chest, and the sand in it stands still — the mark of the god's gaze; (3) a simple robe of the first school, without ornament; (4) his fingers are long and perfectly still; (5) some of the ghostly hourglasses around him are nearly empty. Place: a simple stone courtyard of the first school of Time at dusk in the first age: a few pillars, an open sky, sand drifting upward. Green time-light rises from below and from the hourglasses.
